service-call.name: mantle.order.SalesQuoteIssueServices.send#Quote
service-call.in-map: {orderId:orderId, orderRevision:orderRevision, recipientPartyIds:recipientList, sendMode:(sendMode || null), subject:(subject || null), note:(note || null), operationKey:operationKey}

label.text: Quote ${orderId} cannot be sent now${previewError ? ': ' + previewError.replace(/^(Error: )?([A-Z_]+: )/, '') : ': it must be proposed, valid, and yours to send.'}

${preview.newIssue ? 'Sending issues revision ' + preview.orderRevision + ' of the quote and stores its PDF, ' + preview.fileName + '.' : 'Revision ' + preview.orderRevision + ' was issued already; this sends its stored PDF, ' + preview.fileName + ', again.'}

${preview.sendMode == 'own' ? 'From your mail' + (preview.accountText ? ' (' + preview.accountText + ')' : '') + ', filed on the quote.' : 'From the organization, with its template ' + preview.templateName + '; each delivery is tracked and a failed one can be sent again.'}

default-field.title: Message
default-field.tooltip: Shown above the quote's cover text

submit.confirmation: Send quote ${orderId} to the recipients checked?
